summary.text: Timothy K. Moore is the Republican incumbent for North Carolina's 14th Congressional District. A Kings Mountain attorney, he served in the North Carolina House of Representatives from 2002 to 2025, including ten years as Speaker, before winning election to Congress in 2024. He is seeking a second term after winning the March 2026 Republican primary with 83.0% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: According to his official biography, Moore is a lifelong resident of Kings Mountain, North Carolina, in Cleveland County.
Earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 1992 and a law degree from Oklahoma City University School of Law in 1995.
After passing the North Carolina bar exam, returned to Cleveland County, where his official biography says he has practiced law throughout his career.
Won election to the North Carolina House of Representatives in 2002 and served in it until 2025, representing District 111.

Served as Speaker of the North Carolina House of Representatives from 2015 to 2025. His official biography describes his priorities as Speaker as infrastructure development, education reform, and job creation.
Won the 2024 general election for North Carolina's 14th Congressional District with 58.1% of the vote over Democrat Pamela Genant, succeeding Rep. Jeff Jackson, and took office January 3, 2025.
Serves on the House Committee on Financial Services (Vice Chair) and the House Committee on the Budget for the 2025-2026 Congress.
Won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary with 83.0% of the vote over Kate Barr.
According to his official biography, lives in Kings Mountain and is the father of two sons, McRae and Wilson.
